name: xmake

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

notes: Official get.sh conversion: fixed runfile release replaces git latest lookup and download helper; upstream configure, make and install are retained. Prepared image supplies C/C++ build toolchain and libreadline development files. Functional test compiles and executes a local C application without package dependencies.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.

Fixes reproduced upstream Makefile installation quoting: the PREFIX make variable is passed as a shell-quoted path, preserving install targets while supporting spaces. Upstream does not intentionally forbid spaces.

Disables optional build statistics with the supported XMAKE_STATS=false setting. The first disconnected build exposed downloader probes by the statistics subsystem; the final report requires no guarded downloader calls.
